## MiniMax M3.1 Flash API

MiniMax M3.1 Flash is a large language model by MiniMax, available on the Venice API as `minimax-m3-1-flash`. It runs privately, with zero data retention.

MiniMax M3.1 Flash is a frontier model for coding, agentic workflows, and complex reasoning, with a 1M-token context window, text, image, and video input, and tunable thinking depth from low to max (max by default).

### MiniMax M3.1 Flash API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `minimax-m3-1-flash` | Standard | Private | $0.1875 / $0.75 per 1M |

### MiniMax M3.1 Flash specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | MiniMax |
| Released | Oct 18, 2026 |
| Privacy | Private |
| Status | Stable |
| Context window | 1M tokens |
| Max output | 128K tokens |
| Reasoning effort | Not adjustable |

### How to use the MiniMax M3.1 Flash API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "minimax-m3-1-flash"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "minimax-m3-1-flash",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }]
  }'
```
